It has been represented by [Democrat](Democratic_Party_(United_States) "Democratic Party (United States)") [Liz Krueger](Liz_Krueger "Liz Krueger") since 2002.[[3]](New_York's_28th_State_Senate_district#cite_note-3)

District 28 is primarily based in the [Upper East Side](Upper_East_Side "Upper East Side") of <Manhattan>, but also includes smaller parts of [Gramercy](Gramercy%2C_Manhattan "Gramercy, Manhattan"), [Murray Hill](Murray_Hill%2C_Manhattan "Murray Hill, Manhattan"), and [Midtown](Midtown_Manhattan "Midtown Manhattan"). At only 3 square miles, it is the smallest State Senate district in [New York](New_York_(state) "New York (state)").[[1]](New_York's_28th_State_Senate_district#cite_note-Census-1)[[4]](New_York's_28th_State_Senate_district#cite_note-Leg-4)
